title: A2UI Common Types
description: Common type definitions used across A2UI schemas.

ComponentId.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

CallId.description: The unique identifier for a function call.

AccessibilityAttributes.description: Attributes to enhance accessibility when using assistive technologies like screen readers or model understanding.

label.description: A short string, typically 1 to 3 words, used by assistive technologies to convey the purpose or intent of an element. For example, an input field might have an accessible label of 'User ID' or a button might be labeled 'Submit'.

description.description: Additional information provided by assistive technologies about an element such as instructions, format requirements, or result of an action. For example, a mute button might have a label of 'Mute' and a description of 'Silences notifications about this conversation'.

live.description: Controls screen reader announcements for dynamic updates (WAI-ARIA aria-live). 'polite' waits for user pause; 'assertive' interrupts immediately for alerts.

hidden.description: Hides the element and its children from assistive technologies when true. Default is false.

Extensions.description: Optional extension metadata. Keys MUST be Unicode identifiers (UAX #31). Keys starting with 'a2ui_' are reserved for official extensions.

catalogId.description: The catalog ID for this component, overriding any surface-level default catalogId.

enabled.description: Whether this component and everything drawn inside it answers the user. `false` ignores every gesture (action, combinedActions, option and span taps), refuses input, skips checks, swallows the touch rather than passing it to an ancestor, and reports interactive parts as disabled to accessibility; scrolling a List or Grid still works, a Pager's autoPlay keeps running. It cascades: a component inside a disabled one is disabled whatever its own `enabled` says. The outermost disabled component draws `style.disabled.effect`, 40% opacity by default, at the same size. A value that is missing, fails to resolve or is not a boolean counts as true.

metadata.description: Optional component-level metadata for vendor extensions.

tracking.description: The component's exposure anchor. The renderer evaluates it on demand and hands the payload to the host; deciding what counts as seen, and reporting it, stays with the host. Only an action's own `tracking` reports a click.

platforms.description: Form factors that render this component: `mobile`, `ios`, `android`, `harmony`, `tablet`, `desktop`, `web`, or `tv`. Omitted or empty means every form factor. Exact match; only `PlatformSwitch` falls back to `mobile`.

subscriptions.description: Host events this component listens for. Writing covers the path; null deletes it.

path.description: Literal JSON Pointer written when the event arrives.

Child.description: A reference to a single child component ID.

oneOf.description: A static list of child component IDs.
A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. The `componentId` is the component to use as a template.

path.description: The path to the list of component property objects in the data model.
A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

DynamicValue.description: A value that can be a literal, a path, or a function call returning any type.

DynamicNumber.description: Represents a value that can be either a literal number, a path to a number in the data model, or a function call returning a number.

DynamicBoolean.description: A boolean value that can be a literal, a path, or a function call returning a boolean.

DynamicStringList.description: Represents a value that can be either a literal array of strings, a path to a string array in the data model, or a function call returning a string array.

catalogId.description: The catalog ID for this function, overriding any surface-level default catalogId.

IndexSystemFunction.description: Returns the 0-based index of the current item when rendering a dynamic list from a template. This function MUST ONLY be available when evaluating template items within a list context.

offset.description: Optional. An offset to add to the 0-based index (e.g., 1 for 1-based indexing). Defaults to 0.

IndexValueSystemFunction.description: Returns the current list-template item as JSON. returnType is any: string, number, boolean, object, array, or null, matching the item. MUST ONLY be used inside a list context. Read-only: input components that write back must bind `{ "path": "" }` instead.

SelectedSystemFunction.description: True when the ChoiceGroup option the current scope belongs to is selected, that is when the option's value is in the group's value array. MUST ONLY be used inside a ChoiceGroup option template (or a List nested in one, which answers for its nearest option) and in the group's own action, which runs in the tapped option's scope.

call.description: The name of the function to call.

catalogId.description: The catalog ID for this function, overriding any surface-level default catalogId.

CheckRule.description: A single validation check rule applied to an input component. The condition function or path evaluates to a ValidationResult object.

condition.description: Path or function call evaluating to a ValidationResult object.

Checkable.description: Properties for components that support renderer-side checks.

checks.description: A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity.

Tracking.description: An analytics anchor. Its position decides what it means: on a component it is the exposure anchor, inside an action it is that action's click anchor. A component-level anchor never doubles as the click one, so give each its own id.

id.description: The analytics identifier. Nothing is reported when it is absent or empty.

params.description: Analytics parameters. Each value may be a literal, a `{path}` binding, or a nested pure `{call}`. Values are evaluated when the event is reported, not while the tree is read.

strategy.description: How the host should report this anchor — report every time it is seen, report once, sample it, whatever the host and the service that wrote this card agreed on. Deliberately open: the vocabulary belongs to them, not here. The renderer passes the string through untouched, does not interpret it, does not validate it against a list, and has no default of its own to fall back on when it is absent. Do not turn this into an enum: an anchor's reporting policy is agreed between the service generating the card and the host reporting it, both of which are the same team, so pinning the values here would gate their vocabulary behind a renderer release while adding nothing the host cannot check itself.

Action.description: Defines an interaction handler that can either trigger an agent-side event or call a renderer or agent function. The host registration determines whether a renderer function runs synchronously or asynchronously.

event.description: The event to dispatch to the agent.

name.description: The name of the action to be dispatched to the agent.

userMessage.description: An optional human-readable message describing the action performed by the user, to present in conversation history or user feedback.

context.description: A JSON object containing the key-value pairs for the action context. Values can be literals or paths. Use literal values unless the value must be dynamically bound to the data model. Do NOT use paths for static IDs.

tracking.description: This action's click anchor, reported when the action fires. A click the host took over is never reported.

checks.description: Skip this action when a rule fails. Evaluated after component-level checks.

throttle.description: Leading-only throttle shared by surfaceId + id.

toast.description: Optional message shown when a call is dropped.

oneOf.description: Executes a renderer or agent-side function.

resultPath.description: Write the successful function result to this DataModel JSON Pointer; a relative path uses the action context. Null is stored, not deleted.

tracking.description: This action's click anchor, reported when the action fires. A click the host took over is never reported.

checks.description: Skip this action when a rule fails. Evaluated after component-level checks.

throttle.description: Leading-only throttle shared by surfaceId + id.

toast.description: Optional message shown when a call is dropped.

Surface.title: Surface Container Component
Surface.description: The reserved canonical container component representing an A2UI surface. The Surface component is immutable and always has 'child': 'root'.

FunctionResponse.description: The return response matching a callAgentFunction or callRendererFunction invocation.

functionCallId.description: The unique ID matching the initiating function call.

value.description: The return value of the function.

error.description: An error object indicating failure of the function execution.

HostEnvSystemFunction.description: Reads a host-owned environment value, preferring the card instance over the process. A missing key evaluates to null. The card cannot write this store.

RendererVersionSystemFunction.description: Returns the host rendererVersion semver string.
